title: Laughing Under the Clouds
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In early Meiji Japan, when samurai have lost their swords and crime is rising, the three Kumō brothers, heads of a shrine, ferry criminals to an inescapable prison on Lake Biwa. Eldest brother Tenka raises his siblings Soramaru and Chūtarō after their parents' murder, while the family's hidden duty is to find and destroy the vessel of the Orochi, a demon serpent reborn every 300 years. Betrayal by a trusted friend, a near loss of one brother to the serpent and a final battle follow over six volumes.
life_message: Family bonds and shared duty can carry people through betrayal and darkness, and one should face fate with a smile.
